metadata.question: Did the water extent of Elephant Butte Reservoir decrease between June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Elephant Butte Reservoir in New Mexico - Dates: June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020 - Collections: Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 8 for 2020 - Need to detect water extent using water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds and cloud shadows using QA bands - Calculate water extent using NDWI threshold (typically > 0) - Count water pixels for both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero (B): Water extent increased or stayed same (valid pixel counts exist, calculation succeeded) - A: Water extent decreased (2020 < 1986) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Elephant Butte Reservoir location const reservoir = ee.Geometry.Point([-107.19, 33.15]).buffer(5000); // 2. Date definitions const date1986 = '1986-06-12'; const date2020 = '2020-06-09'; // 3. Landsat 5 for 1986 let col1986 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date1986, ee.Date(date1986).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1986 = col1986.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images found: ${size1986}`); if (size1986 === 0) { // Try wider date range col1986 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate('1986-06-01', '1986-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1986_wide = col1986.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images (wider range): ${size1986_wide}`); if (size1986_wide === 0) { console.log('No data for 1986'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Landsat 8 for 2020 let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date2020, ee.Date(date2020).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images found: ${size2020}`); if (size2020 === 0) { // Try wider date range col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate('2020-06-01', '2020-06-30') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size2020_wide = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images (wider range): ${size2020_wide}`); if (size2020_wide === 0) { console.log('No data for 2020'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Process 1986 image const img1986 = col1986.first(); const green1986 = img1986.select('SR_B2').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir1986 = img1986.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi1986 = green1986.subtract(nir1986).divide(green1986.add(nir1986)); const water1986 = ndwi1986.gt(0); // 6. Process 2020 image const img2020 = col2020.first(); const green2020 = img2020.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir2020 = img2020.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi2020 = green2020.subtract(nir2020).divide(green2020.add(nir2020)); const water2020 = ndwi2020.gt(0); // 7. Calculate water extent (pixel counts) const stats1986 = water1986.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2020 = water2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels1986 = stats1986.get('SR_B2').getInfo(); const waterPixels2020 = stats2020.get('SR_B3').getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Water pixels: ${waterPixels1986}`); console.log(`2020 Water pixels: ${waterPixels2020}`); // 8. Validation and answer if (waterPixels1986 === null || waterPixels2020 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (waterPixels1986 === 0 && waterPixels2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (waterPixels2020 < waterPixels1986) { console.log('Water extent decreased'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water extent did not decrease'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
